blocking_preconditions.consequence: a rescue launched today would run law=None, i.e. v1 verbatim, and spend up to 1241 oracle calls reproducing the same candidate exhaustion
blocking_preconditions.measured: on commit 7210f666 no production caller passes region_law=. t4_fiber_campaign.py line 264 calls synthesize_dynamic_program(source, rng, max_modules=horizon) with no region_law, and t4_fiber_campaign.py is not modified by the commit. The only references to BridgeRegionLaw outside its own module are its tests and two probe scripts

ceiling_derivation.finding: every one of the seven attempts across the five cells charged exactly 1 call and terminated at status=candidate_exhaustion in round 0, so the cells are exhaustion failures, not partially-spent searches
ceiling_derivation.method: read every attempt directory on each parent volume; a result.json payload states charged_calls directly, and a lock-only attempt is one forfeited reserved call under publish_before_docking with automatic_retries=0
ceiling_derivation.note: the coordinator supplied 248/248/248/248/249; this artifact re-derives the same values from the volumes rather than inheriting them
ceiling_derivation.rule: rescue_ceiling = 250 authorized per cell - measured lifetime charged calls

payload.claim_boundary: SEPARATE, VERSIONED RESCUE. These are region-repair rescue runs under their own contract identities, apps and volumes, at per-cell ceilings below the arm's 250. They must never be spliced into the unchanged-v1 250-call panel table without being named as a rescue: the budgets differ, the run ids and volumes differ, the proposal law differs, and each cell's lifetime spend is its prior attempts plus whatever the rescue charges. Name the configuration and the rescue phase, or run the matched confirmation

5ht1b_2.classification: a two-layer gap -- region shape plus an executor charge-policy decision -- not a budget question; no amount of docking will close it
mechanism: its witnesses need a different region SHAPE, not a larger one: a two-boundary interior excision plus ONE reattachment bond, which the region-draw law does not draw

even given that region the production executor refuses it: charge_policy_preserved runs at every step and 9 of 16 pendant regions on that source are refused by the charge policy, with zero refusals on every neutral cell
bond_insert is outside the frozen Active8 codec surface, so the reattachment primitive would have to be cycle_close
5ht1b_2.separate_dead_cell_note: 5ht1b_2 on the d04 arm is ALSO a dead cell with one forfeited root call and no result, recorded in diagnostics/t4_held_target_5ht1b_2_d04_recovery_blocked_v1.json. That is an infrastructure loss and is independent of this exclusion, which is about the repair not reaching its witnesses

exclusions_carried_forward.chemistry_screen: keep the screen narrow; benchmark eligibility, quality screening and synthetic-suitability remain separate claims, and no filter is added while support survives
exclusions_carried_forward.protonation: no protonation or charge-state edit enters this rescue. The protonation route is a separate configuration (configs/t4_shared_retained_fiber_5ht1b2_protonation_rescue_v1.json) and must not be folded in: mixing it would make the rescue's mechanism unattributable

mechanism.name: bridge-separated region-draw law (pruning repair)
mechanism.opt_in_surface: region_law= on compile_generic_module / synthesize_dynamic_program / synthesize_named_module_sequence; law=None preserves v1 byte-identically
mechanism.reported_effect_not_reverified_here: the coordinator reports best-eligible mass ranks improving on three failed cells with no control regression, and delete-half census coverage rising from 0/41. Those numbers are RELAYED, not re-measured in this session

reconciliation.grouping: _standings groups by (target, seed_index, delta), so a rescue attempt and its parent attempts group together and the furthest-progressed is selected while the others stay visible in other_attempt_runs
reconciliation.lifetime_spend_rule: lifetime charged calls for a cell = prior attempts + rescue calls; the reconciler reports per attempt and never adds them
reconciliation.note: each rescue arm must be registered in ARMS before launch so it is visible from the moment its contract exists; the tool now reports an arm whose volume is not yet readable as unlaunched instead of failing the whole reconciliation
reconciliation.status_polling_caveat: remote_status hardcodes ('parp1_0','parp1_1','parp1_2'), so mode=status on any non-parp1 arm reports not_started regardless of progress. Round locks are the authority; poll the volume

trigger_rule.rule: a rescue triggers on MEASURED candidate exhaustion only, never on target identity and never on losing to the IVG comparator
